notes.title: 📢 Scooby-Doo DLC: launch date announced! 🗓️
notes.content:
Ever since we dropped the news about the very first paid House Flipper 2 DLC - officially licensed by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment - things may have seemed a little too quiet around here. Behind the scenes though, we're working extra hard to make this year's Halloween an absolute menace for all the House Flipper 2 fans.

If you missed the original reveal of the Scooby-Doo DLC for House Flipper 2, here’s your chance to catch up:

[previewyoutube=Vpl4FboGYfs;full][/previewyoutube]
Yup - it’s coming, it’s close, Scoobtober is almost here! 👻

Here’s a bone-chilling reminder of what’s waiting for you:
🦴 Six new mysterious jobs with various challenges that increase in difficulty and connect to the overarching mystery.
🦴 Six new haunted properties related to classic Scooby-Doo monsters that allow players to express their creative freedom,
🦴 Three new themed assemblies,
🦴 New special buyers to discover,
🦴 Over 500 new items, including Scooby-Doo-themed ones,


[h3]🎃 House Flipper 2 - Scooby-Doo DLC launches October 23, priced at $19.99 USD![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672960/House_Flipper_2__ScoobyDoo_DLC/


We're so glad to finally share the release date and price! Soon, we'll also be revealing more insights and sneak peeks to help make the wait more bearable!

Whether you’re a mystery-solving pro or just here for the spooky vibes, this DLC brings the iconic world of Scooby-Doo into the renovation universe of House Flipper 2. Expect classic locations, familiar characters, and ghostly surprises waiting behind every creaky door.

So better grab some Scooby Snacks, keep your magnifying glass ready, and stay tuned — because this October… it’s time to flip some haunted houses!

notes.title: 🤡 It's April Fools' Day! (Mini-Update!)
notes.content:
[hr][/hr][h3]🥳 April fool! [/h3]

Howdy Flippers!

Today, we bring you a little something to make your April Fools' Day more fun!
This is our first official "Mini-Update" - that's our new term to describe some of the smaller content additions to House Flipper 2.

[previewyoutube=hKiMi6kEubs;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr][h3]📋 Let's take a quick look at the changelog:[/h3]

[b]New:[/b]
• 6 April fools-related items so you can prank someone!
• A new mug with custom picture functionality!

[b]Changes:[/b]
• We lost a batch of our sound files, but we MacGyvered smth up overnight, and we're working on a more permanent solution. Be patient. (47 new sounds, but you can actually switch back to the original ones in the main menu! Only available on April 1st)

[b]Fixes:[/b]
• Pinnacove suburbs achievement is now correctly recognized.
• Fixed unremovable sills in the recently added house, "The Alligator Bar" in Old Pinnacove. The fix applies only to newly bought houses.

[b]Co-op changes:[/b]
• You can now disconnect from a co-op game using the Back button during loading (after confirming in a pop-up). Yes, now this is a feature, not a bug!
• Additional gameplay elements now synchronize properly: wall finish material held in hand, as well as paint roller mode and color.
• Third-person animations have been added for switching the cleaning tools and spray usage.
• Added additional notifications for "Lobby Full" and "Local Connection Not Possible".
• Crossplay status can now be toggled from the client join view.

[b]Co-op fixes:[/b]
• Fixed time of day synchronization.
• If the host is in the main menu, clients will also be placed in the main menu upon joining.
• If a player joins while others are still connecting or cleaning windows, they will no longer find them in an awkward position or animation.
• Cleaning the same stain is no longer slower when multiple players clean it together. Teamwork makes the dream work, not the job harder!

[b]❗ Additionally, we saved you from potential malicious features:[/b]
• Removed your favourite "before and after" gallery because at least 3 players didn't like it.
• Removed the co-op mode so you can finally enjoy playing alone in peace.
• All your mod.io houses got deleted because we forgot to pay our monthly mod.io premium subscription... what an awesome chance to upload new player creations!
• All textures are now one color (gray) to boost performance.
• Removed paint roller – now you must dip your hands in paint and slap the walls manually.
• Fixed a bug where only cold water was flowing from the taps.
• Removed all houses larger than 25m² or containing more than 20 items or 5 light sources – these could lead to uncontrollable crashes.
• Added an "ive-got-a-crash-on-you" command so you can now controllably crash your game as much as you like! (use at your own risk)



This marks our second step of the Q1 / Q2 2025 House Flipper 2 Roadmap.
What comes next is one of the biggest events of the year for the House Flipper Franchise, so make sure to stay tuned!

notes.title: 🫢 Haven't talked about the Community Contests in a long while!
notes.content:
Today we wanna go for a bit of a Community Contest discussion, a nice little topic to focus on before the next contest arrives! ːbessie_uwuː

We'd like to talk about the 2 recent ones, the "Monster Mansion" and the "Coziest Christmas" contests, as well as hear your ideas about the contest that's coming along with the March update!
"What March update?!?"... well, if you haven't seen our recent roadmap news, check it out:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1190970/announcements/detail/627792097481588797

So, when it comes to picking the winners of the Community Contests, it gets harder and harder as we're constantly experiencing our community reaching new levels of creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.
The moment when you go through a house built by one of the contestants, you stare at a specific part of the project and you're like [i]"wow... wait... how did they even build that??"[/i]... such a great feeling that is! ːbessie_loveː

Better see for yourself:

[previewyoutube=Fm3G7VStZ3o;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=ZCkwrqnYaec;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]🏆 Let's discuss the winning projects![/h3][hr][/hr][i]We feel like projects with a noticeably high level of attention to detail are the ones that shine the brightest! Both the recent contests were extremely competitive, and we can't wait to see more![/i]



🎅 [b]The Coziest Christmas Community Contest:[/b]

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/old-rich-christmas]1. Old Rich Christmas by surdegen1230[/url][/b]
Xmas vibes overflow but in an outstanding style! Soooo many details and unique ideas! The environmental storytelling is there too! The looks are awesome, capturing the warm and cozy Christmas vibes perfectly. The best fit for the theme!

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/xmas-at-santa]2. Xmas at Santa! by ImSoff[/url][/b]
A bunch of interesting ideas and elements. What would be more Christmasy if not a night at Santa's place? Huge attention to detail mixed with a solid design and great execution! The proper vibes are there too, making this another great fit for this contest!

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/not-even-a-mouse]3. Not even a mouse. by birbiegorl[/url][/b]
Cozy, fantastically looking, and has a spinning Christmas tree! We really appreciated how some of the inner walls were made, what an awesome detail! The whole interior design regarding decorations and some style altering between different rooms is great to see!

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/cozy-christmas-tudor]4. Cozy Christmas Tudor by jessfess27[/url][/b]
Awesome usage of the environment! The little Christmas fair, the tree house, and the houses around which have some Christmas decor on them! Lovely choice of colors and a fantastic feel for the amount and placement of all the decorations! So cozy!


[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/home-for-the-holidays]5. Home for the Holidays[/url][/b]
This project proves that you don't need extreme ideas in order to stand out, you can do that with quality instead! This house feels so lived in, and the quality of it lies in all the little details you see everywhere around. Beautiful, cozy, Xmasy, great job!



👻 [b]The Monster Mansion Community Contest:[/b]

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/bloodthorn-manor]1. Bloodthorn Manor by RooseGarden[/url][/b]
The versatility here is insane! Every aspect of this project presents an outstanding level of detail, and that's what led us to this choice. The outer shell, the environment setup, the interior with secret rooms, and a bloody vampiric story vibes! We strongly believe that bigger doesn't mean better, but it's hard to avoid appreciating the sheer size of the Bloodthorn Manor.

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/the-scholars-mansion]2. The Scholar's Mansion by A_Mushroomm[/url][/b]
We couldn't believe it when we saw the little details regarding the story of this place! Don't mess with the demons! The house itself feels nicely executed and incredibly well synchronized with its story background. The overall vibe of this project resonates really well with what the Monster Mansion Contest was about!

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/nightshade-hollow]3. Nightshade Hollow by Wabsie[/url][/b]
Incredibly unique! The little ghost butler's hands performing different actions, and the usage of lava-induced structures made this idea really stand out. Everything fits the theme and again presents a very high level of attention to detail.

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/marys-mansion]4. Mary's Mansion by Bunny_Bananya[/url][/b]
Surprisingly bloody... and awesome! Make sure to find the underground secrets! The little stains that function as a form of navigation are something we strongly appreciate! On top of that the architecture of this project is very stylish.

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/coffee-creatures-dwelling]5. Coffee Creature's Dwelling by jessfess27[/url][/b]
Another great story to uncover! You can really feel the consistency of the project, everything fits right in! We loved seeing all the details outside the main house, and the interesting + super stylish choice of colours!

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/haunted-hill]6. Haunted Hill by Ninjahd055[/url][/b]
Interesting project with a huge bunch of spooky elements. The blood trails guide you through all the little story pieces, but you can also see how much work went into the environment creating an eerie atmosphere. Great fit for the theme!

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/haunted-house5]7. The Haunted Sinclair House by IloveMaidboys[/url][/b]
The dark vibes hit you hard with this one! Creating old and damaged houses takes a lot of skill to do properly and requires some serious attention to detail. Really good execution of an old haunted spooky building, with a bit of a monster story thrown in as well!

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/the-hunted-scrolls-of-stonehaven-manor]8. The Hunted Scrolls of Stonehaven Manor by surdegen1230[/url][/b]
We loved the outer shell, great style! The area around the house is nice and detailed, and we get to play a little game about finding all the missing scrolls! Creative and well built!

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/shadow-hills]9. Shadow Hills by Vick84[/url][/b]
Solid aesthetics, both regarding the inside and outside. The project fits the theme very well, bringing you more spooky vibes! Can you follow the trail and find the hidden cave?

[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/baba-yagas-hut-monster-mansion-contest]10. Baba Yagas Hut by H2887[/url][/b]
We saw this idea already, but turning it into a spookier version worked well! With a bit of a story included, this house feels like a proper fit for the theme, and amazes the viewer with the details!




[h3]🤔 What about the next contest?![/h3][hr][/hr]
Looking for ideas!

As mentioned, we're planning to start the next contest on the day of our next Major Update release which comes somewhere in March! We can already see a couple of promising themes for it, like a spring/gardening theme (pretty much the theme of the update) or something related to April Fool's Day!

Let us know what you guys think in the comments, and have a lovely last week of February!
Cheers! ❤️

notes.content:

• Snowmen and snowballs - give them a throw!

• Resizable fairy lights

• Fir branches and mistletoe
• 3 new sculptures
• 2 new pillow sizes!
• 2 new picture frames
• Christmas ornaments and an ornament stand
• Christmas wall decor and a wall decor stand
• Pine cones and orange slices
• Christmas stockings to hang on your fireplace
• 6 cute winter lanterns
• Christmas crackers, figurines, and a nutcracker
• A table runner

• Blackberry and raspberry bushes
• Holly bushes and a holly tree
• Poinsettia plants

notes.title: 🎉 House Flipper 2 CO-OP Playtesting - Phase 2!
notes.content:
[h3]📰 Big news for the House Flipper 2 CO-OP fans![/h3]

Today we're starting [b]the second phase of House Flipper 2 CO-OP playtesting[/b], as we'd love to see more people trying out the current state of this upcoming feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/08f49795b33656791e0349ad563b0bd96882e446.png[/img]

We have recently gone through a very small phase of CO-OP playtesting where we allowed a real tiny portion of our playerbase to access the feature. [b]We verified that it works in an acceptable way, so here goes phase 2![/b] 🥰

The biggest change is that this time, everyone who'd like to have a chance to get access to the CO-OP feature playtest can [b]sign up for it through Steam[/b]!



[h3]🔓 How to apply for access?[/h3]

[b]No 3rd party websites[/b] - just a straightforward [b]"Request Access" button[/b] on the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1190970/House_Flipper_2/]House Flipper 2 Steam Store Page[/url][/b], go check it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1190970/House_Flipper_2/


[b]Remember that signing up for the CO-OP feature doesn't instantly mean that you'll be granted access![/b] Closed alpha or beta tests in the world of gaming are closed for a reason, and especially with online features like CO-OP, making it a process based on expanding phases is crucial for the development path of the feature. For now, it's even more important, as we're specifically focusing on how different server load levels influence the feature and its stability.

😭 We'd love to allow you all to hop in, but that would in fact prolong the development process! 😭

Also, keep in mind that even though this feature is one of our main focuses regarding the future of the game, it is currently [b]nowhere near being finished[/b], so expect bugs, crashes, and other pesky occurrences that might take away from the fun!

Have a wonderful week y'all! 💙

notes.title: House Flipper 2 Status Report 📋
notes.content:
[h3]👋 How's it going Flippers?[/h3][hr][/hr]
Today, [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1190970/announcements/detail/6106382177078964041?snr=2___]exactly a month after the official House Flipper 2 release[/url][/b], I greet you with a little wall of text, as I'm pretty sure a lot of you are waiting for information regarding the current status of House Flipper 2, and what exactly the team at Frozen District is focused on after the release. The winter holiday season is finished, we're all back in the office, and we know that the future weeks will be full of work and dedication.

Let's do a little dev diary to discuss the current situation, as well as where we're headed regarding our development efforts:



[h3]🚧 The current situation[/h3][hr][/hr]
House Flipper 2 is up and running, and we feel like the official release was a huge success - a success that wouldn't be possible without your help and support! Looking at the feedback from the community we can see that a lot of you love the game and are super satisfied with the purchase.
[b]BUT!...[/b]

That's sadly not true for all the House Flipper 2 players, and we know that there's still a lot of work ahead of us. Luckily, the Flipper community once again showed us its value, and we received a lot of constructive criticism regarding many different aspects of the game. The biggest quest for us at the moment is gathering, analyzing, and evaluating all this feedback. That's something we've been doing for the last couple of weeks, and we already have an idea of what the priority list looks like for us.

[b]Currently, we're definitely focusing our attention on bugs[/b], especially the ones that are blocking some players from playing House Flipper 2. What I mean by that is mainly all the saving-related issues that either wipe your progress or block the saving mechanism thus preventing you from progressing in the game.
We also have some other cheeky ones, like the infinite scrolling bug that you guys let us know about [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1190970/discussions/0/]through our Steam Discussions[/url][/b]. Thank you all for reporting those, and any other issues. Our testers and programmers are already on it!

A lot of you also pointed out that House Flipper 2 is missing some crucial content pieces, for example, [b]curtains and window blinds, or the beloved Before/After mechanic[/b]. We're fully aware of that, and thanks to our new [b][url=https://houseflipper2.canny.io/]House Flipper 2 Roadmap and Feature Board[/url][/b], we can see what your votes are and what features are the most important to you and your gameplay experience. Thank you for taking part in the voting!



[h3]🔮 The future[/h3][hr][/hr]
[b]Our first hotfix update is already planned to come next week if everything goes smoothly[/b]. This one will cover a portion of the most serious issues ([i]those that we could fix fairly quickly[/i]), but keep in mind that some of them require a little bit extra time on our side.
That's why we're also already working on another hotfix update that will come after that. We will make sure to keep you updated about the situation on our [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1190970/discussions/2/]Steam Discussions[/url][/b].

Moreover, while our programmers are tracing all the bugs and working on the fixes, a part of the development team is also busy with the upcoming [b]Spring Content Update[/b] ([i]which we'll be discussing sometime in the following weeks![/i]), and [b]our artists are already creating new item sets![/b]
Take a look at this little sneak peek:

notes.title: First ever House Flipper 2 Feature Update!
notes.content:
[h3]🎙️ The last couple of days were full of your suggestions![/h3]

Since the release, you guys have been very active on various player-developer communication channels.
Thanks to that, we were able to discover some overlooks on our side and decided to act quickly before the winter holiday break!

For the last week, we tried gathering as much feedback as possible, especially keeping a close eye on our  [b][url=https://houseflipper2.canny.io/]new feature request board on Canny.io[/url][/b]!

[hr][/hr]If you don't know what [b][url=https://houseflipper2.canny.io/]Canny.io[/url][/b] is, it's a platform where our players can:[list]
[*] See what we have planned for the future of House Flipper 2
[*] Influence this plan by commenting on and upvoting the things that they think are a priority.
[*] Create posts that contain player ideas for new content. These posts can then be upvoted by the rest of the community members and implemented into the House Flipper 2 roadmap.[/list]

Click the banner below or one of the above links to join the fun!

[url=https://houseflipper2.canny.io/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/35de3c1ae8b0e60c39d78465ddbdecb2634f383a.png[/img][/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]📜 The Feature Update patch notes:[/h3]

Today, we're delivering some simple, yet very effective quality-of-life features which were instantly requested by our community right after the release:[list]

[*] Added a [b]Hold / Toggle option[/b] inside the Settings > Gameplay Tab. This feature works with:[list]- painting
- general cleaning
- window cleaning
- wall building
- vacuuming[/list]([b]Important:[/b] the tooltips will still suggest that you're using the hold option, don't worry about it, we'll change that soon!)

[*] Added options for [b]inverted X/Y mouse movement settings[/b] in the Settings > Gameplay Tab.
[*] Added WASD tooltips when painting and cleaning windows.
[*] Added a popup suggesting lower graphics settings in case of a game crash.
[*] Optimized window cleaning to work better on low-end GPUs.
[*] The game now triggers an autosave upon entering the assembly mechanic.
[*] Fixed disappearing assembly elements!
[*] Fixed the issues encountered during the drilling phase in the assembly mechanic.
[*] Property photos are now getting automatically exported along with uploading the property to Mod.io
[*] The popup about not being able to sell your parents' house is now displayed properly.
[*] Added support for all keyboard layouts (yikes!).
[*] Added variety regarding TV shows on different properties.
[*] Reflections should no longer go crazy on your GPU memory.
[*] Optimization improvements for various stains.
[*] BIGGER FONTS for Steam Deck users![/list]


We also performed a couple of tests regarding [b]motion sickness[/b] in House Flipper 2
Generally, what seems to be working is:[list]
[*] Turning off FSR [i](but we still love AMD!)[/i]
[*] Turning off Motion Blur
[*] Disabling V-Sync and setting your fps to match your monitor refresh rate.[/list]


[hr][/hr]
[i]That's it, folks! We will be back with more updates in 2024!
Cheers, have a wonderful rest of the week! ❤️[/i]

notes.title: House Flipper 2 Gamescom Report + Giveaway!
notes.content:
Dear Flippers,

This is going to be a little bit of a "behind the scenes" post, as we'd like to delve into the adventures we experienced during most likely the biggest gaming industry event of the year - Gamescom 2023, on which we went for it and revealed the release date for House Flipper 2!

At the same time, we'd like to warmly thank everyone who attended the event and send special kudos to those who visited our booth. Being there really showed us how numerous (the number of people was just crazy!), chatty (loved chatting with you guys about some nostalgic retro game vibes... and about HF2 of course!), and stylish (don't even get me started on the crazy cosplays!) the global gaming community is!


[hr][/hr]
[h3]But let's start from the beginning, right?[/h3]

August 21 was officially the first day of the event... but! A special Frozen District team was tasked with appearing in Cologne a couple of days earlier to make sure everything regarding the construction of our booth as well as the technological support of it goes according to the grand plan.

We all started packing, and the very first of our agents arrived in Cologne on August 19. The next morning, they approached the exhibition halls ready to check and report the situation!
Fortunately, everything about the booth itself looked great, and we had some outstanding PCs waiting for us ready to be unpacked and put into action. The preparations got into top gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/46f8f9d26b7d635d88e82db1789ee907f2f86cdc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/d14ee945eed44255a92a3cf6cda2d7aa89ca5a61.jpg[/img]
The rest of the "Frozen District + Frozen Way Gamescom crew" arrived in the late evening of August 20. After a pretty long trip, we had a chance to get some proper sleep and prepare ourselves for whatever came the next day.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]The action starts![/h3]

The first day of the event was the press day, so it was a bit chill!
We had a great time talking with influencers and press from all around the world, and we had a blast streaming for you live from Gamescom to reveal the release date of House Flipper 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/0eacef28bacf29be704fcab43408bf6718ac4241.jpg[/img]
And then it all started!
With our eyes wide open,
our House Flipper 2 knowledge sharpened,
and our social batteries charged to the maximum,
[b]WE FACED THE GAMERS![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/f0499b78c99cc1818ac59e8081a2981ddf340253.jpg[/img]
Our booth at a constant maximum capacity, going strong, not giving up!
Our defense strategy? Well, we had to come up with some DIY ideas for some tiny issues, and as always the answer is DUCT TAPE! Optimize the queues!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/1fac53252e9ebb8dec813981ddb47dbb2bae1c9e.jpg[/img]
More and more waves of gamers were arriving at the booth. We had a chance to meet lots of newcomers experiencing flipping for the first time, as well as some really hardcore Flippers with hundreds or even thousands of hours of playtime.

I gotta admit that the excitement and energy from the House Flipper fans queuing up to play the HF2 demo and chat with us was on a completely different level!

notes.title: Building from scratch in House Flipper 2?!
notes.content:
Welcome to yet another House Flipper 2 Development Blog!
Along with this one, there comes a serious dose of excitement!

Why is that?... Because for the first time, in House Flipper history, we could show you what building from scratch will look like!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1190970/House_Flipper_2/

[h3]Why is [b]building from scratch[/b] such a big topic?[/h3]

Building houses from the ground up, on an empty plot of land is something our community has been asking us an incredible amount of times over the recent years. It's a topic we've been thinking about and discussing for many many months prior to finally making a certain decision.

With the very beginning of House Flipper 2 development, we knew that this is the time to bring it on and make the dreams of many players a reality, and here it is!


[h3]The first-ever showcase of [b]House Flipper 2's Sandbox Mode![/b][/h3]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1190970/view/3672159223605208067]Just like we previously promised[/url][/b], with this Devlog we decided to change things up a little bit, and instead working on a pre-recorded material, we felt like a livestream is going to be the best choice to present the [b]Sandbox Mode![/b]

It was probably the longest developer stream we ever hosted, but we managed to successfully introduce you to the whole process of building your own dream house in House Flipper 2:

[previewyoutube=tZf6DwVH_kY;full][/previewyoutube]
Keep in mind that these are only the highlights so if you missed our stream, and would like to watch all of it, head over to our Twitch channel ( https://www.twitch.tv/frozen_district ), or check out the recording directly under [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FpoXUBQphlQ]THIS LINK[/url][/b].

Also, remember that this time our aim was to show you working on the exteriors only. In the future, roughly about 2 months from now, we will host another Developer Stream, in which we will delve into the topic of [b]interior design in the Sandbox Mode.[/b]

On a final note, I'd like to once again thank everyone who joined us on the House Flipping journey!
It's always an amazing feeling for us, the devs, to be open and transparent about this project, and an even better feeling to experience so much support and compassion from the House Flipper gaming community! [b]You guys rock![/b]

Till next time!

[i]~ Reczberg together with grateful developers from Frozen District :)[/i]
